comments.body:
Final debug report before merge

Problem: unrelated nested conftest changes selected all seven mutation shards, wasting contentious Ubuntu runner time without loading those fixtures.

Proven root cause: .github/mutation-shards.toml placed tests/**/conftest.py in global_support. scripts/mutation_gate.py treats any global_support match as all shards, while runtime tracing showed pytest loads only a selected test directory and ancestor conftests.

Proof: every configured shard was traced; the complete loaded set was tests/conftest.py plus five non-root ancestor conftests. tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py was absent. Across 97 completed Verify runs, seven candidate over-triggers consumed 19,353 runner-seconds, 322.6 runner-minutes, or 5.38 runner-hours. Pytest, Jest, and Nx all support dependency-accurate affected-test selection rather than sibling/global invalidation.

Test: tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py::test_manifest_conftest_support_matches_selected_test_ancestry was RED against the original manifest, 1 failed in 0.17s, then GREEN after the held-out mapping fix, 1 passed in 0.56s. Removing a required interfaces dependency and adding stale Jira DC support each returned the final oracle to RED, 2 of 2 defect-seeded mutations killed. The complete mutation-gate file now passes 42 tests.

Fix: commit dd9f52a12d40acdbeeeab16e53d13aeb38ebef52 keeps only tests/conftest.py globally and assigns each non-root conftest to exactly the shards whose configured tests load it. The contract independently expands configured test files and directories, derives ancestor conftests, pins source/test and non-conftest globals, and checks exact selector ownership.

Scope and safety: the only selector consumer already distinguishes global_support from per-shard support. No caller depends on unrelated sibling conftests selecting every shard. No production capability, dependency, or test coverage was removed; no existing assertion was weakened. Exact shard-test union after updating to origin/main: 374 passed, 1 skipped, 1 existing warning in 23.07s. Config-check, Verify parity, lint, typecheck over 542 files, and diff checks passed.

Siblings: repository sweep found no remaining tests/**/conftest.py invalidator. The manifest is the single configuration surface; no parity surface is missing.

Residual risk and prevention: fixed in scope by the derived ancestry equality contract. If a future directory test entry gains nested collected tests and a conftest, expansion of test_*.py files makes that conftest an ancestor and fails closed until mapped. The single Gerrit change can be reverted to restore the recursive fail-safe if live evidence contradicts the trace.

Replication: direct selector execution now returns zero shards for tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py; unit conftest selects signing, compact-policy, and push-policy; interfaces conftest selects signing, reducer-processors, next-batch, gates, and validate; root tests/conftest.py still selects all seven. Gerrit change 1797 is pending both required votes: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1797.

compiled_state.description:
## Context
`.github/mutation-shards.toml` currently treats recursive `tests/**/conftest.py` as global support, so a change to any nested conftest selects all seven mutation shards. Across 97 recent completed Verify runs, seven proven candidate over-triggers consumed 322.6 runner-minutes (5.38 runner-hours) without increasing coverage. A top-level `tests/conftest.py` change genuinely affects all shards, but pytest only loads conftests in a test's directory and its ancestors—never sibling fixture trees. A runtime trace over every configured shard found the complete loaded ancestor union is exactly six files: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/unit/conftest.py`, `tests/interfaces/conftest.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/conftest.py`, `tests/scripts/conftest.py`, and `tests/scripts/reducer/conftest.py`. The union of all shard tests still passes (374 passed, 1 skipped in 23.30s).

## Prior decisions and OSS research
No tracker ticket contains or rejects this exact proposal. `frowsy-beggarly-mammoth` rejected deleting a whole workflow from global support because that loses coverage; this change retains every dynamically loaded fixture dependency. `nostalgic-crumby-tick` requires support-input mapping, true mutation-infrastructure changes selecting all shards, isolated evidence, and no verdict cache; this satisfies those constraints. Three active OSS projects converge on dependency-accurate affected-test selection: pytest documents upward-only conftest discovery; Jest uses inverse dependency resolution for `--findRelatedTests`; Nx maps changed support inputs to owning/dependent projects while reserving true-global inputs for all targets. Consensus approval therefore applies only with per-shard ownership and a fail-closed drift contract.

## Plan
- Remove the recursive conftest global-support pattern. Keep only `tests/conftest.py` as true global conftest support.
- Put `tests/unit/conftest.py` in the per-shard support lists for signing, compact-policy, and push-policy only.
- Put `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` in the per-shard support lists for signing, reducer-processors, gates, next-batch, and validate only; signing loads it through `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py`.
- Put `tests/interfaces/store/conftest.py`, `tests/scripts/conftest.py`, and `tests/scripts/reducer/conftest.py` in reducer-processors support only.
- Add a deterministic contract that expands each shard's configured test files/directories, derives their present ancestor conftests, and asserts the per-shard manifest support closure equals that derived set while the true-global root remains global.
- Add selection cases proving unrelated nested conftests select no shard and each declared ancestor selects exactly its dependent shards.
- Extend the manifest contract to pin all existing non-conftest global-support entries and each shard's existing source/tests arrays, proving this edit does not alter unrelated mappings or true mutation-infrastructure triggers.
- Prove fail-closed drift by defect-seeding a missing derived ancestor or stale extra conftest entry and observing the contract fail.
- Run focused mutation selector/contracts, the union of configured shard tests, lint, typecheck, and workflow/action policy gates.
- If post-merge evidence exposes an unmodeled fixture dependency, revert this single Gerrit change to restore the recursive fail-safe, then add the dependency to the derived contract before retrying.
- Land through Gerrit and measure avoided mutation runner occupancy on a later unrelated nested-conftest change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The manifest keeps only `tests/conftest.py` as conftest global support and contains no recursive conftest glob.
- [x] Each non-root ancestor conftest appears only in the support lists of shards whose configured tests load it.
- [x] Signing support includes both `tests/unit/conftest.py` and `tests/interfaces/conftest.py`.
- [x] A contract derives and compares the per-shard ancestor-conftest closure from configured shard test paths.
- [x] The contract fails on a missing dependency or stale extra conftest entry.
- [x] An unrelated nested conftest change selects no mutation shard.
- [x] Each true ancestor conftest change selects exactly its dependent mutation shards.
- [x] A contract pins every pre-existing shard source/tests mapping unchanged.
- [x] A contract pins every pre-existing non-conftest global trigger unchanged.
- [x] All configured shard tests execute with unchanged pass/skip results.
- [x] Focused tests, lint, typecheck, and applicable workflow guards pass.
- [x] Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 precede merge.
